title: Action-Guided Reachability for Deterministic World Models of Vision-Based Systems
abstract: arXiv:2512.08991v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: End-to-end vision-based controllers map raw camera images directly to control actions, yet verifying their closed-loop behavior remains challenging: no analytical model maps a physical state to a camera image, and propagating a set of states through high-dimensional images yields loose reachable sets. We address both challenges with two techniques. First, we propose a Deterministic World Model (DWM), a latent-free decoder that generates camera images only from the physical state, trained with a saliency-weighted reconstruction loss and a control-consistency loss. The DWM replaces the camera in the closed loop, so a sound and tight reachable tube of the surrogate closed loop can be computed without bounding any latent variables. Second, we propose an action-guided partition-and-verify scheme that certifies as many initial sets as possible within a fixed computation budget. A Gaussian process learned from cheap simulations orders

translated_title: 面向基于视觉系统的确定性世界模型的动作引导可达性分析
translated_abstract: 端到端的基于视觉的控制器将原始相机图像直接映射为控制动作，然而验证其闭环行为仍然具有挑战性：不存在将物理状态映射为相机图像的解析模型，且通过高维图像传播状态集合会产生过于宽松的可达集。我们用两种技术来应对这两个挑战。首先，我们提出了确定性世界模型（DWM），这是一种无潜变量的解码器，仅从物理状态生成相机图像，并通过显著性加权的重建损失和控制一致性损失进行训练。DWM在闭环中替代了相机，因此无需对任何潜变量进行界定，即可计算出替代闭环的可靠且紧凑的可达管道。其次，我们提出了一种动作引导的划分-验证方案，在固定的计算预算内尽可能多地认证初始集合。从廉价仿真中学习得到的高斯过程对（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出无潜变量的确定性世界模型（DWM）来替代闭环中的相机，并结合动作引导的划分-验证方案，实现了对端到端视觉控制器闭环行为可靠且紧凑的可达性验证。
en_tdlr: Proposes a latent-free Deterministic World Model (DWM) to replace the camera in the closed loop, combined with an action-guided partition-and-verify scheme, enabling sound and tight reachability verification of end-to-end vision-based controllers.
